target.name: Matic Robotics
target.founder: Navneet Dalal, Mehul Nariyawala, Shafaq Presswala

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $7M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Matic Robotics is a seed-stage consumer tech company founded by Navneet Dalal, Mehul Nariyawala, and Shafaq Presswala. The company has raised $107M to date. Valuation benchmarking against direct sector peers is not feasible; no comparable public or private consumer tech robotics companies were available for reference.

Given limited methodological optionality, valuation relies on stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($107M) as a proxy for prior valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, the analysis yields an implied valuation of $18M. This reflects the expected multiple applied at stage transitions within the consumer tech sector, absent transaction comps.

The triangulated range is $15M (low) to $20M (high), with $18M as median. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method and absence of comparable market transactions to validate stage-based assumptions. Key uncertainties include whether the total-raised proxy accurately reflects prior valuation inflection points, and whether sector-standard step-up multiples apply to this company's specific risk profile and capital efficiency. Transactions in robotics subsectors and consumer hardware would materially sharpen the analysis.
